incidents.name: GNUS Axelar ITS salt reuse unauthorized mint
incidents.notes: The GNUS deployer key was leaked through a Discord compromise and reused the project's Axelar Interchain Token Service salt to register a same-ID token manager on Fantom, so minting worthless GNUS there made the ITS executor mint 500,000 canonical GNUS to the attacker on Ethereum, which was then sold into the Uniswap V2 GNUS/WETH pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: exploit tx emits Transfer(0x0 -> 0x548c63a6a7299ab54762e1bfa6b56c1b94c2a820, 500000 GNUS) on the token 0x614577036f0a024dbc1c88ba616b394dd65d105a; the tx is signed by the Axelar ITS executor 0xc77820eef59629fc8d88154977bc8de8a1b2f4ae, so the attacker EOA recorded here is the mint recipient that dumped into the pool in 0xe8a5780cc89d9115acf307da9e6fae68e8b3634a8b41c77d81e95edb9085a407. Token created 2024-02-20 by the GNUS deployer 0x1804deca63705e18edf04f242b325bcd54a8b463 (the wallet whose key leaked), not by the attacker; it is a Diamond, so facet changes emit no EIP-1967 Upgraded event and the age may be overstated. Tier-1 measurement: the diamond emits DiamondCut(...) rather than EIP-1967 Upgraded, and eth_getLogs over [creation 19269335, incident 19802980] returns 10 DiamondCut events - block 19269335 (2024-02-20, deployment cut), 19273203/19273274/19273280/19273284/19273286/19273329/19273367/19273421 (all 2024-02-21) and a final one at block 19762552 (2024-04-29T17:47:59Z, tx 0x5d1ca14aa4eb0ce2c6f953fe6f3856bfbecbfb0945ec9a8420fb61d8152d0808) that re-cut the ERC20 and mint/burn facets six days before the exploit, so the age is measured from that cut (5.65 days) instead of deployment (74.8 days).

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2024-04-29T17:47:59Z (block 19762552, tx 0x5d1ca14aa4eb0ce2c6f953fe6f3856bfbecbfb0945ec9a8420fb61d8152d0808): last DiamondCut(...) event (topic 0x8faa70878671ccd212d20771b795c50af8fd3ff6cf27f4bde57e5d4de0aeb673) emitted by the diamond 0x614577036f0a024dbc1c88ba616b394dd65d105a before the incident; it re-cut the ERC20/mint-burn facets (including 0x40c10f19 mint and 0x9dc29fac burn on facet 0x48a1831a8f4f701c26c0f72b1b7fa68aa3ae4731)
